verdict.rationale: Canny advertises automatic capture from Gong, Intercom, Slack and 'dozens of other sources' plus a one-click MCP connection for ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor requiring no API keys or engineering, suggesting easy third-party connections. However, no evidence describes an actual integrations marketplace or setup UI for these tools, and API/OpenAPI probes returned 404, so ease-of-setup for the broader integration list beyond MCP is unverified.
